description: Discover perpetual pairs on the radar: filter the scanner's 300 strongest pairs by coin or symbol substring, exchange, receiving side, minimum |hourly rate| or 24h volume; sort by rate, volume or open interest. Each row carries the rate in both forms, the receiving side, next settlement, volume, OI and the card link. A pair outside the 300 is reachable via pair_briefing by its exact symbol.

lang.description: Language of the summary and links: 'en' (default) or 'ru'

minHourlyPercent.description: Minimum |rate| in percent per hour, e.g. 0.05

query.description: Coin or symbol substring, case-insensitive (BTC, 1000PEPE, USDC)

receiver.description: Who receives funding: long (negative rate) or short (positive)

name: pair_search

data.description: Compact numbers the conclusion is based on, units named inside

link.description: Live page with the same data

title: Find pairs: by coin, exchange, side, rate or volume
